def macsearch(f, n, start, p0, fixed, rings, dash, w=3.0, cap=120000, maxcost=60, cells=None):
    import heapq
    S,FD,FI=prep(f)
    D=bfsdist(FD,[c for c in FD if xc2(c)&set(dash)])
    if cells is None: cells=[(dr,dk) for dr in (-2,0,2) for dk in (-2,0,2)]+[(0,2),(2,0),(0,-2),(-2,0)]
    def dsc(pos): return (sum(p[0] for p in pos)//n, sum(p[1] for p in pos)//n)
    def inbb(a,c): return abs(a[0]-c[0])<=2 and abs(a[1]-c[1])<=2
    def macros(st):
        pos,pl=st; x=dsc(pos); out=[]
        obs=list(pos)+list(fixed)
        for i in range(n):
            cost=1 if i==pl else 2
            for dr,dk in cells:
                cell=(x[0]+dr,x[1]+dk)
                if any(inbb(cell,c) for c in obs): continue
                if cell not in FI: continue
                np_=list(pos); np_[i]=cell; np_=tuple(np_)
                nx=dsc(np_)
                if nx in FD: out.append(((np_,i),cost,('mov',i,cell)))
            for rc in rings:
                if any(inbb(rc,c) for c in obs): continue
                if rc not in FI: continue
                np_=list(pos); np_[i]=rc; np_=tuple(np_)
                if dsc(np_) in FD: out.append(((np_,i),cost,('ring',i,rc)))
        return out
    st=(start,p0)
    if xc2(dsc(start))&set(dash): return [],0
    h0=D.get(dsc(start),99)
    pq=[(w*h0,0,st,[])]; best={st:0}; exp=0
    while pq:
        _,g,s,path=heapq.heappop(pq)
        if best.get(s,99)<g: continue
        exp+=1
        if exp>cap: return None,'cap'
        for ns,c,a in macros(s):
            g2=g+c
            if g2>maxcost: continue
            if best.get(ns,999)<=g2: continue
            best[ns]=g2
            if xc2(dsc(ns[0]))&set(dash): return path+[a],g2
            heapq.heappush(pq,(g2+w*D.get(dsc(ns[0]),99),g2,ns,path+[a]))
    return None,'exhaust'

def joint(f, start, p0, w=3.0, cap=150000, maxcost=62):
    import heapq
    S,FD,FI=prep(f)
    GDASH=[(50,54),(50,56),(51,53),(51,57),(52,52),(52,58),(54,52),(54,58),(55,53),(55,57),(56,54),(56,56)]
    PDASH=[(54,33),(54,35),(55,32),(55,36),(56,31),(56,37),(58,31),(58,37),(59,32),(59,36),(60,33),(60,35)]
    DG=bfsdist(FD,[c for c in FD if xc2(c)&set(GDASH)])
    DP=bfsdist(FD,[c for c in FD if xc2(c)&set(PDASH)])
    RINGS=((53,55),(57,34))
    CELLS=[(dr,dk) for dr in (-2,0,2) for dk in (-2,0,2)]+[(0,2),(2,0),(0,-2),(-2,0)]
    def dg(p): return (sum(p[i][0] for i in range(4))//4, sum(p[i][1] for i in range(4))//4)
    def dp_(p): return ((p[4][0]+p[5][0])//2,(p[4][1]+p[5][1])//2)
    def inbb(a,c): return abs(a[0]-c[0])<=2 and abs(a[1]-c[1])<=2
    def H(pos): return DG.get(dg(pos),99)+DP.get(dp_(pos),99)
    def win(pos): return bool(xc2(dg(pos))&set(GDASH)) and bool(xc2(dp_(pos))&set(PDASH))
    def macros(st):
        pos,pl=st; xg=dg(pos); xp=dp_(pos); out=[]
        lp=list(pos)
        for i in range(6):
            cost=1 if i==pl else 2
            x = xg if i<4 else xp
            for dr,dk in CELLS:
                cell=(x[0]+dr,x[1]+dk)
                if any(inbb(cell,c) for c in pos): continue
                if cell not in FI: continue
                np_=list(pos); np_[i]=cell; np_=tuple(np_)
                if dg(np_) in FD and dp_(np_) in FD: out.append(((np_,i),cost,('mov',i,cell)))
            for rc in RINGS:
                if any(inbb(rc,c) for c in pos): continue
                if rc not in FI: continue
                np_=list(pos); np_[i]=rc; np_=tuple(np_)
                if dg(np_) in FD and dp_(np_) in FD: out.append(((np_,i),cost,('ring',i,rc)))
        return out
    st=(start,p0)
    if win(start): return [],0
    pq=[(w*H(start),0,st,[])]; best={st:0}; exp=0
    while pq:
        _,g,s,path=heapq.heappop(pq)
        if best.get(s,99)<g: continue
        exp+=1
        if exp>cap: return None,'cap'
        for ns,c,a in macros(s):
            g2=g+c
            if g2>maxcost: continue
            if best.get(ns,999)<=g2: continue
            best[ns]=g2
            if win(ns[0]): return path+[a],g2
            heapq.heappush(pq,(g2+w*H(ns[0]),g2,ns,path+[a]))
    return None,'exhaust'

def macsearch3(f, n, start, p0, fixed, rings, goalpred, hfun, cells, w=2.5, cap=150000, maxcost=45):
    import heapq
    S,FD,FI=prep(f)
    def dsc_(pos): return (sum(p[0] for p in pos)//n, sum(p[1] for p in pos)//n)
    def inbb(a,c): return abs(a[0]-c[0])<=2 and abs(a[1]-c[1])<=2
    def macros(st):
        pos,pl=st; x=dsc_(pos); out=[]; obs=list(pos)+list(fixed)
        for i in range(n):
            cost=1 if i==pl else 2
            for dr,dk in cells:
                cell=(x[0]+dr,x[1]+dk)
                if any(inbb(cell,c) for c in obs): continue
                if cell not in FI: continue
                np_=list(pos); np_[i]=cell; np_=tuple(np_)
                if dsc_(np_) in FD: out.append(((np_,i),cost,('mov',i,cell)))
            for rc in rings:
                if any(inbb(rc,c) for c in obs): continue
                if rc not in FI: continue
                np_=list(pos); np_[i]=rc; np_=tuple(np_)
                if dsc_(np_) in FD: out.append(((np_,i),cost,('ring',i,rc)))
        return out
    st=(start,p0)
    if goalpred(start): return [],0
    pq=[(w*hfun(start),0,st,[])]; best={st:0}; exp=0
    while pq:
        _,g,s,path=heapq.heappop(pq)
        if best.get(s,99)<g: continue
        exp+=1
        if exp>cap: return None,'cap'
        for ns,c,a in macros(s):
            g2=g+c
            if g2>maxcost: continue
            if best.get(ns,999)<=g2: continue
            best[ns]=g2
            if goalpred(ns[0]): return path+[a],g2
            heapq.heappush(pq,(g2+w*hfun(ns[0]),g2,ns,path+[a]))
    return None,'exhaust'

def gen_clicks(pos, pl, macros, ringcenters=(), dash=()):
    pos=list(pos); clicks=[]
    def inb(p,c): return abs(p[0]-c[0])<=2 and abs(p[1]-c[1])<=2
    for (kind,i,cell) in macros:
        x=dsc(pos)
        if pl!=i:
            d=pos[i]
            cands=[d]+[(d[0]+a,d[1]+b) for a,b in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0),(0,2),(0,-2),(2,0),(-2,0))]
            pick=None
            for cd in cands:
                if inb(cd,x): continue
                if any(inb(cd,rc) for rc in ringcenters): continue
                if cd in dash: continue
                pick=cd; break
            if pick is None: pick=d
            clicks.append((pick,i,'des'))
            pl=i
        clicks.append((cell,i,'mov'))

def prep4(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    seg=f.segmentation
    # S obstacle = largest S component
    best=None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S' and (best is None or n['pixels']>best['pixels']): best=n
    b=best['boundary']
    r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
    S=set((r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if a[r][c]=='S')
    return a,S
def ring4(f):
    seg=f.segmentation; a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==1 and n['color'] not in ('B','W','S','N','M','Y','O','b','R','r','p','G','g','w','P'): pass
    # rings: 12 dashes each, radius 3 from center; detect by scanning candidate centers
    cols=set('MPYOSrNbpR')
    cand=[]
    for r in range(3,61):
        for c in range(3,61):
            d=[(r-3,c),(r+3,c),(r,c-3),(r,c+3),(r-2,c-2),(r-2,c+2),(r+2,c-2),(r+2,c+2)]
            if all(a[x][y] in 'MPYSrNYObRpg' for x,y in d) and a[r][c]=='B':
                cand.append((r,c))
    # dedupe nearby
    out=[]
    for x in cand:
        if not any(abs(x[0]-y[0])<=2 and abs(x[1]-y[1])<=2 for y in out): out.append(x)
    return out
